newsitem.title: USA: Tyco sees $0.01-$0.02 EPS from ElectroStar.
newsitem.headline: Tyco sees $0.01-$0.02 EPS from ElectroStar.

text.p: Tyco International's $106 million proposed acquisition of circuit board maker ElectroStar Inc would double Tyco's circuit board business and add about $14 million, or between $0.01 and $0.02 a share, to the company's 1997 earnings per share, a Tyco executive said.

"It's a nice broadening of our circuit board market," said David Brownell, a senior vice president at Tyco. "They're very heavily into telecommunications and we cover aerospace very heavily." Tyco's $106 million cash offer values ElectroStar's 7.5 million shares at $14 each.
ElectroStar's $70 million in yearly revenue would bring Tyco's circuit board revenue to about $140 million annually, Brownell said.
The acquisition should close sometime in late December, he added.
